lead.t: When you have an obstructive lesion (aortic valve stenosis, pulmonary valve stenosis, coarct etc) if its in the mild to moderate or begining of the\nsevere stage it is Acyanotic Heart Disease but once it reaches the critical i.e. very severe then it becomes Cyanotic Heart Disease
